quests.title: Pizza From Another Land

dialogue.t: Oh, hello. Can I help you with something?
Oh, that pizza tastes really good.
But...how do I put this, I'm not very used to its flavor.
I just think that if you can mix some of Inazuma's local ingredients into the pizza, such as Lavender Melon...
Maybe, the pizza will be more popular with everyone.
*sigh* Maybe I'm really not good at making pizza...
Traveler, you've returned.
How did it go, any feedback?
Pizza made with Lavender Melon... That's not too complicated...
The rest of the ingredients just need to be prepared as usual. Well, since the feedback said to "incorporate some of Inazuma's local ingredients," then I can add some other ingredients...
Hmm, Sea Ganoderma? Naku Weed? Oh, how about Fluorescent Fungus...
Oh! I'm sorry, I was busy thinking about what ingredients to put in! Let's see, I don't think there's much Lavender Melon left in the store...
Traveler, please help me get a Lavender Melon. When it comes to ingredients...this should be all that's missing.
Mm, I'm counting on you, then. Just one Lavender Melon will do.
Pizza made with Lavender Melon... I wonder how it tastes...
Have you brought the ingredients back with you?
Thank you, these ingredients will do.
I wonder what a pizza made with Inazuma's local ingredients would taste like...
It's done!
This pizza looks... pretty good...
Thanks for your help, Traveler. Here, these are for you.
I'll make sure to savor this pizza's taste...
If it's not bad...it should be officially launched as a new dish soon.

quests.description: Kiminami Anna from the Kiminami Restaurant seems to be bothered by something…
